name: Tarn's Lair
accessNote: Tarn's Lair is south of the Haunted Mine in southern Morytania; the terror dog room is the chamber where Tarn Razorlor was fought during the Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest (Haunted Mine required). A slayer ring teleport is the fastest access; the trek on foot is long and dangerous (Skeleton mages, traps). The terror dog room is multi-combat, drains Prayer at 1 point per 2 ticks (50/minute), and cannot host a dwarf multicannon. Terror dogs can be safespotted from Tarn's room with Magic or Ranged once tolerant. Burst is left false as it is not wiki-confirmed here.
